# Title, controls, autodock to TRIX II, market, jobs, equipment,
# take-off, a fight with the job's pirates, then the map and the chart.
# Starts on the title screen with a save present (CONTINUE first).
wait 4
tap down 2            # CONTROLS
wait 0.5
tap ok
wait 2.5
tap down 4
wait 2
tap back
wait 0.8
tap down              # NEW GAME (the title cursor is back on CONTINUE)
wait 0.6
tap ok
wait 5
hold back 0.7         # flight menu
wait 1
tap down 2            # TARGET
wait 0.6
tap right             # TRIX II
wait 1.2
tap down              # AUTODOCK
wait 0.8
tap ok
wait 20               # warp, approach, landing
tap ok                # MARKET
wait 1.5
tap down 3
wait 0.5
tap right 2
wait 2
tap back
wait 0.8
tap down              # JOBS
tap ok
wait 1.2
tap down 2            # HUNT 2 RAIDERS
wait 2
tap ok
wait 1.5
tap back
wait 0.6
tap down              # EQUIP
tap ok
wait 1
tap down 2            # MISSILE
wait 0.5
tap ok 2
wait 1.5
tap back
wait 0.6
tap down              # STATUS
tap ok
wait 2
tap down 3
wait 1.5
tap back
wait 0.6
tap back              # take off
wait 3
hold back 0.7
wait 1
tap down              # ATTACK NEAREST
wait 1.2
tap ok
wait 8
hold ok 2.5
wait 2
tap ok 2              # missile
wait 4
hold ok 3
wait 3
hold back 0.7
wait 0.8
tap ok                # ATTACK NEAREST again (cursor stays)
wait 6
hold ok 3
wait 2
tap ok 2
wait 4
hold ok 3
wait 3
hold ok 3
wait 3
hold back 0.7         # system map
wait 0.8
tap down 4
wait 0.4
tap ok
wait 3
tap down 2
wait 2
tap back
wait 0.6
tap down              # GALAXY CHART
tap ok
wait 2.5
tap right
wait 2
tap down
wait 2
tap back

wait 2
